symbols.description: Get the UI widget properties, use `widget.getProperty(hmUI.prop.MORE, {})` to get all the properties of the widget.
Set the properties of the UI widget.

props.name: val
props.description: Set the value. (when property is hmUI.prop.MORE, val is used in the same way as createWidget's option, which can set multiple parameters.)

props.name: x
props.description: The x-axis coordinate of the component.

props.name: y
props.description: The y-axis coordinate of the component.

props.name: VISIBLE
props.description: Whether the widget is visible or not, true is visible, false is not, this property does not support setProperty(hmUI.prop.MORE, {}), only setProperty sets the VISIBLE property alone
